items.title: George "Pops" Foster Interview, 1958-08-24
items.q: I played with old papa, I think he was around 90 some years old, still blowing his horn.

ctx.x: Johnny Dawes played some nice low register stuff.

You see? Because I'm talking about guys who played low register. I'm talking about guys who played low register, climate. He, see? Because I don't know. You see? Oh, Johnny was with them kind of fellas. You see, the fellas, what I'm talking about, played climate. Yeah. Old man Teo, old papa Teo. I played the level. When I played the last year, I played with old papa, I think he was around 90 some years old, still blowing his horn. George Fields, I think just died here lately. I think he's dead. Yeah, he died. He…
He died about, kind of like, going out on the lighter. He died about five or six years ago.
